scope: Illustrative extrapolation only; not an approved cohort/lock or a guaranteed runtime. Ready counts from entity metadata, no Final forecasts/labels decoded. Old dense 43-day one-target timing, linear 90/43 projection, three seeds and 14 distinct runs. Excludes tuning/convergence/retries/input preparation and does not model compact-I/O speedups or heterogeneous station workloads.
formula: cells = ready_entities_in_namespace_budget_role * 3 seeds; projected_seconds = measured_43_day_elapsed_seconds * (90/43) * cells, summed over all 14 distinct method runs and three budgets
